title: Hand Dryer Bina Button Kaise Chalu Hota Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Hand dryer bina button dabaye kaise chalu ho jaata hai? Jawab hai ek chhota sa IR sensor!
🔦 IR LED ki invisible 940 nm beam
🔬 Photodiode ke andar electrons ka khel
🧠 LM393 comparator aur blue pot ka kaam
🔌 FC-51 module ko Arduino se kaise jodein
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karo!

Hand dryer ko pata kaise chalta hai aapka haath? 🤔
Bina button dabaye dryer chalu hota hai, iske peeche ek chhota IR sensor hai. Dekho andar kya hota hai 👇
🔦 IR LED ~940 nm ki invisible beam bhejti hai
🔬 Haath se takra kar roshni photodiode me wapas aati hai
🧠 LM393 comparator threshold se compare karta hai
🔌 Output LOW hote hi OBS LED jalti hai
💾 Save karo, Arduino project me kaam aayega
📤 Bhejo us dost ko jo har cheez ka 'kaise' poochta hai
💬 Aapke yahan ka dryer kabhi atka hai? Batao!
